note: Accent test set (/record): the same standard-Korean sentences for every speaker, no dialect words, so accent alone tells the regions apart. Covers interview-style answers, yes/no and wh-questions, connective endings, phrases opening with aspirated or tense consonants, ㅚ/ㅙ/ㅞ, ㅓ, ㅆ and ㅐ/ㅔ words, and long sentences with several accentual phrases.
